name: Mohamed Habib Soula
headline: Product engineer. Six systems shipped to production in three years.
subline: Flutter apps, TypeScript backends and the agentic tooling that ships them, owned end to end from the first client call to the release.
intro: I own products from the first client call to the release: the data model, the Flutter app, the TypeScript backend and the deploy. At **Value Digital Services** I build banking, insurance and HR apps for the BIAT group and its clients. As an independent engineer I build event platforms, booking agents and data pipelines for clients in Tunisia, France and Dubai.
Most of that code is private client work. The numbers above count it, and the sections below describe it.

projects.name: Budgywell
projects.text: Every change is written on the phone first, then synced as idempotent commands into an append-only, double-entry ledger guarded by Postgres row-level security.

projects.name: Focale OS

projects.name: Shiplog
projects.tagline: AI coding sessions → one shareable HTML file
projects.text: Finds sessions from Claude Code, Codex, Aider, OpenCode and Amazon Q, then renders a self-contained log with grouped tool calls and syntax highlighting.

projects.text: Runtime GLSL fragment shaders, five SDF shapes, a stable-fluids simulation and adaptive rendering tiers with accessible fallbacks.

projects.name: oh-my-pi
projects.tagline: On-demand tool discovery for a coding agent
projects.text: Merged #916: the agent starts with four tools and finds the rest by BM25 search, which cuts about 11k tokens from the first prompt. Also merged #833.
